U3-err-matter.file_folder_clash.en: Clauseo can't restore this paper: a folder now has its name, or the folder it was in is now a file. Nothing has changed. Rename or move that folder or file, then try again.
U3-err-matter.file_folder_clash.hi: Clauseo यह दस्तावेज़ पुनर्स्थापित नहीं कर सकता: अब एक फ़ोल्डर का यही नाम है, या जिस फ़ोल्डर में यह था वह अब एक फ़ाइल है। कुछ नहीं बदला है। उस फ़ोल्डर या फ़ाइल का नाम बदलें या उसे कहीं और ले जाएँ, फिर दोबारा प्रयास करें।
U3-err-matter.file_folder_clash.hi_by: host follow-ups (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
U3-err-matter.file_folder_clash.note: matter.file_folder_clash: Versions' Restore this document refused, the paper's name now a folder or its folder now a file; nothing written. Id form required by status.test.ts (one U3-err-<code> per ErrorCode)

UC-392.en: '{paper}' had changed since you opened this, so Clauseo restored it as it was then. Your newer version is kept in Versions.
UC-392.hi: इसे खोलने के बाद '{paper}' बदल गया था, इसलिए Clauseo ने उसे वैसा पुनर्स्थापित किया जैसा वह तब था। आपका नया रूप संस्करणों में रखा गया है।
UC-392.hi_by: host follow-ups (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-392.note: Versions' line after a one-document restore whose paper changed while the dialog was open (the dialog asked again, then the restore wrote); the restore's outside-edits version keeps the newer copy (restore.rs step 4, before the write)

UC-393.en: Undid the restore. '{paper}' wasn't in this matter before it, so Clauseo moved it to the Trash.
UC-393.hi: पुनर्स्थापन पूर्ववत किया गया। '{paper}' उससे पहले इस मामले में नहीं था, इसलिए Clauseo ने उसे Trash में डाल दिया।
UC-393.hi_by: host follow-ups (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-393.note: Versions' line after undoing a one-document restore that had brought the paper back (it is in the undo's removes), once the undo's marker says the host moved it to the computer's bin (not in VersionRestored.deleted); Mac and Linux. Windows: UC-394. Deleted for good: UC-399

UC-394.en: Undid the restore. '{paper}' wasn't in this matter before it, so Clauseo moved it to the Recycle Bin.
UC-394.hi: पुनर्स्थापन पूर्ववत किया गया। '{paper}' उससे पहले इस मामले में नहीं था, इसलिए Clauseo ने उसे Recycle Bin में डाल दिया।
UC-394.hi_by: host follow-ups (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)

UC-395.en: Nothing was undone: Clauseo couldn't safely put '{paper}' back, so it left it as it is.
UC-395.hi: कुछ पूर्ववत नहीं हुआ: Clauseo '{paper}' को सुरक्षित रूप से वापस नहीं ला सका, इसलिए उसे जैसा है वैसा ही छोड़ दिया।
UC-395.hi_by: host follow-ups (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-395.note: Versions' line after undoing a one-document restore whose marker lists the paper neither written nor removed, or that answered with no marker: the host left the paper (changed since, online-only, a case-only twin). Chosen from the marker, never the dialog's preview. English final (app track)

UC-396.en: Clauseo can't restore this paper: there's now a folder called '{name}' where it was. Nothing has changed. Rename or move that folder, then try again.
UC-396.hi: Clauseo यह दस्तावेज़ पुनर्स्थापित नहीं कर सकता: जहाँ यह था, वहाँ अब '{name}' नाम का एक फ़ोल्डर है। कुछ नहीं बदला है। उस फ़ोल्डर का नाम बदलें या उसे कहीं और ले जाएँ, फिर दोबारा प्रयास करें।
UC-396.hi_by: host follow-ups (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)

UC-397.en: Clauseo can't restore this paper: '{name}', the folder it was in, is now a file. Nothing has changed. Rename or move that file, then try again.
UC-397.hi: Clauseo यह दस्तावेज़ पुनर्स्थापित नहीं कर सकता: '{name}', जिस फ़ोल्डर में यह था, अब एक फ़ाइल है। कुछ नहीं बदला है। उस फ़ाइल का नाम बदलें या उसे कहीं और ले जाएँ, फिर दोबारा प्रयास करें।
UC-397.hi_by: host follow-ups (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-397.note: matter.file_folder_clash naming one of the paper's folders (HostError.files): it is now a file; {name} is that file's own name

UC-398.en: '{paper}' comes back as it was then, next to '{current}', which stays as it is. You can undo this.
UC-398.hi: '{paper}' वैसा ही वापस आ जाएगा जैसा तब था, और उसके साथ '{current}' भी जैसा है वैसा ही रहेगा। आप इसे पूर्ववत कर सकते हैं।

UC-398.note: Restore this document's dialog for a paper renamed since (compared as a rename): it comes back at its old name, and the renamed copy {current} stays, so the lawyer has both. A paper removed since keeps UC-320

UC-399.en: Undid the restore. '{paper}' wasn't in this matter before it, so Clauseo removed it. A copy stays in Versions.
UC-399.hi: पुनर्स्थापन पूर्ववत किया गया। '{paper}' उससे पहले इस मामले में नहीं था, इसलिए Clauseo ने उसे हटा दिया। उसकी एक प्रति संस्करणों में रहती है।
UC-399.hi_by: host follow-ups (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)

UC-341.hi: कुछ पुनर्स्थापित नहीं हुआ: Clauseo '{paper}' का वह संस्करण सुरक्षित रूप से वापस नहीं ला सका, इसलिए उसे जैसा है वैसा ही छोड़ दिया।
